title: Hat of Destiny
logline: Michael pulls Secret Santa names out of a coffee mug and turns the Christmas party into a battlefield, while Pam's Stamford gift from Jim forces her to tell Roy she is not happy.
outline: A: Michael runs a Secret Santa draw from his Hat of Destiny while Angela and Kelly fight over the party theme; he draws Toby, gives him a real card, and asks how he is. B: Pam draws Jim from the Stamford exchange, gets paints, and tells Roy she is not happy. C: Dwight and Andy bet on who drew whom; Angela's gift to Dwight ends it. Order: cold, A, C, B, A, B, A, C, B, A, C, A, tag.
theme: Who do you choose when you finally have to choose? Secret Santa is a lottery of who you are assigned to love.
storySoFar: Jim is in Stamford dating Shannon Doyle and working with Karen Filippelli; Pam's unanswered card sits in her drawer, and she is secretly taking Tuesday watercolor classes that Michael knows about and promised to keep quiet about, or maybe not. Roy has set a June 14 wedding date; Pam told him she is not happy, and he says he knows. Michael read Gerald Boyd's letters as love and called Favorite Week; he now knows the staff wrote them from fear, and he asked Toby how he is and waited for the answer. Corporate calls the letters unnecessary. Dwight and Andy must share the Pruitt Paper account and will drive to Dale's office Thursday, speaking in turns. Angela and Dwight's secret is known to Oscar and Kevin and is now half-public. The Christmas party is planned by Angela's committee, and Kelly is fighting her over the theme. Stanley is stuck at 187 days; Kevin closes every countdown joke with "Nobody say nothing."

real friendship forming; Michael gave him a card and waited for the answer
secret relationship half-exposed at the Secret Santa reveal

stateChanges.progress: Jim sent Pam paints as Stamford Secret Santa; Pam told Roy she is not happy; card still unanswered

stateChanges.arc: Michael Wants to Be the Favorite
stateChanges.progress: Michael drew Toby, gave him a real card and asked for the real answer; he is learning presence over favorites

stateChanges.arc: Dwight vs Andy for Number Two
stateChanges.progress: Bet on Secret Santa; agreed Thursday turns for Dale's office

scenes.recap: Michael launches Secret Santa from a coffee mug and tries the countdown joke on Stanley at 187; it dies.

beats.text: Secret Santa! Names in the Hat of Destiny, and nobody leaves this bullpen without a gift from me.
Actually, the Party Planning Committee set a fifteen-dollar limit.
Ten dollars is my limit. Ten dollars is a feeling.

beats.caption: holds up a Dunder Mifflin mug stuffed with folded names

beats.text: Stanley, one eighty-seven days! That's what she said.
Nobody say nothing.

scenes.recap: Angela and Kelly fight over the party theme, and Michael's Hat of Destiny becomes the compromise; Pam draws a name and hides it fast.

beats.text: The Christmas party is a Party Planning Committee event. Theme: Winter Gala. Fifteen dollars. Nothing else.
Winter Gala sounds like a funeral with a cheese plate. It's Holly Jolly Hollywood, and I already pitched it to Ryan.
Ryan's a Hollywood guy, Kelly. He's basically a—
Ryan is a temp.

lines: Kelly wants a party with a red carpet made of tinsel. I want a party where nobody cries into the punch.
Last year someone cried into the punch. It was Michael.

beats.text: Okay. Compromise. The Hat of Destiny. Secret Santa decides who we are to each other.
Michael, that's just a Secret Santa, and it's a little bit of a fire hazard in a mug.
Could we just do Secret Santa? Like normal people?
Pam, you're the peacemaker. You go first.

beats.caption: unfolds a slip, goes very still, and hides it under her notepad

beats.text: Who is it? Is it me? It's not me, is it?
It's Stamford. They're in the hat.

scenes.recap: Dwight and Andy bet on who drew whom, Kevin holds the M&M pot, and Andy's banjo hold music interrupts.

beats.text: Question: does Kevin hold the pot?
Kevin hold pot. Kevin also hold bet. Same thing.
I bet you five M&Ms Angela drew you, Dwight.
False. I drew Andy. Andy drew Kelly. I am the only one with a plan.

lines: Secret Santa is a test of loyalty. I have passed it every year since I was twelve.
Andy has passed it zero times. Andy has passed a banjo off as a phone.

beats.caption: bear-paw phone starts playing banjo hold music

beats.text: Actually, that's a banjo on hold.
It's a Cornell hold song, Oscar. It means I'm in charge.

scenes.recap: A FedEx box from Stamford arrives for Pam: Jim's Secret Santa gift is a tin of watercolors.

beats.caption: tears open a flat box stamped Stamford at reception

beats.text: Is it from Ryan? Ryan doesn't send things.
It's from Stamford. Secret Santa.
Stamford? Is that from Jim? I'm not saying anything. I'm not Jim.

beats.caption: holds up a tin of watercolors with a small card tucked in the lid

beats.text: Hope someone gets to paint something this year. Secret Santa.

lines: He sent paints. From Stamford. He didn't write his name, which is so Jim.
Michael knows about my Tuesday class. Michael is not Jim. Michael is very clear about that.

scenes.recap: Michael draws Toby from the Hat of Destiny, tries to trade him out, and is refused.

beats.text: Toby! I drew you.
Okay.
Trade with me? I'll give you a five-dollar bill for your slip.
No.
That's a Toby no.
It's just a no, Michael.
Okay. It'll be the best fifteen dollars of your life. I'm spending ten.

lines: I'm not upset. I'm strategic. Toby is the one person in this building who doesn't want to be my favorite.
That's a good place to start.

scenes.recap: Pam tells Roy the paints are from Jim and then says she is not happy.

beats.text: Halpert sent you that?
It's Secret Santa, Roy.
Stamford Secret Santa. Sure. I got the binder. Tabs and everything.
Roy, I'm not happy.
Is it the binder?
It's me. I'm not happy, and I've been saying it in a drawer for months.
I know. I've been seeing it since the binder got heavy.

lines: I'm not going to yell in a warehouse. I'll yell in the parking lot.
But she said it. She didn't have to say it to me, and she did.

scenes.recap: Michael offers a hearts-and-cats compromise for the party theme and Kelly calls his kindness disgusting.

beats.text: Compromise! Hearts on the right, cats on the left!
Left is correct. Cats are a Party Planning Committee standard.
Right is correct. Hearts are the only thing a party needs.
I just want everyone to feel loved. Like, really loved. In a warm way.
Michael, you're being disgusting. Just a little bit. Stop it.

lines: Kelly's red carpet is made of tinsel. Tinsel is a fire hazard, and Toby agrees with me.
I don't agree with Kelly about anything, and that's how I know I'm right.

beats.text: Actually, the compromise is a sixteen-dollar tinsel cat. Which is over the limit.
Then the tinsel cat wins.

scenes.recap: Dwight and Andy agree to speak in turns on Thursday's drive to Dale's office and shake on it.

beats.text: Question: who did you draw?
Confidential. Like Cornell's legacy admissions.
Thursday. Dale's office. We drive in the van. You talk first, I talk second.
False. I talk first. You talk second. We split the bullet points.

beats.caption: hums a three-note a cappella warm-up at the dumpster

lines: Andy and I are a temporary alliance. We are two fleets in Battlestar Galactica sharing one planet until the Cylons arrive.

beats.text: Turns, Dwight. Deal?
Deal, Andy. Do not sing in the van.

scenes.recap: Pam tells Phyllis she told Roy she is not happy, and Phyllis says the question is what Pam wants.

beats.text: Is that paint, Pam? Is it from Stamford?
I told Roy.
Told him what, sweetie?
That I'm not happy.
Good. Now the question is what you want.
I don't know.
Yes you do. You've been drawing it in a drawer for months.

lines: Phyllis is terrifying in a cardigan. She's right, which is worse than being wrong in front of Kelly.

beats.text: Want a Staples pretzel? Don't tell Dwight. It's evidence.

scenes.recap: Michael gives Toby a card and asks how he is, then actually waits for the answer.

beats.caption: sets a small gift bag and an envelope on the table

beats.text: Michael, the limit is fifteen dollars.
It's a pencil sharpener and a card. Open the card.
How are you, Toby? For real. I'm going to wait.
Honestly? I'm a little lonely around the holidays.
Okay. Thank you for telling me.
Thanks, Michael.

lines: Michael is the worst boss I've ever had. He's also the only one who ever asked.
I don't know what to do with that. I'm going to keep the sharpener.

scenes.recap: The Secret Santa reveal settles the bet, and Angela's gift to Dwight makes their secret public.

beats.text: Pot is M&Ms. Andy win.
I guessed Angela drew Dwight. I have a gift for the cat-ornament guy.
False. I drew Andy. Andy drew Kelly.

beats.caption: hands Dwight a gift bag with a small cat ornament

beats.text: It was a legal draw, Dwight. Take the cat.
Actually, the odds were one in twelve. Dwight was the only one with a cat-shaped plan.
False. I knew the whole time.
Oh my God. Angela and Dwight. Tell me everything.

scenes.recap: Stanley hands Michael a real pretzel and Kelly calls Michael's kindness disgusting, and Stanley nods.

beats.text: Your gift. Don't make it a thing.
A pretzel. A real one, Stanley. Not Staples. This is the best gift I've ever gotten.
Michael's kindness is disgusting. Just giving that to everybody today.
Thank you, Kelly. I'm going to take that as love.
That's what she said.
One eighty-seven. Thanks, Michael.

scenes.recap: After the party, Michael tries the countdown joke one more time and Kevin closes it out.

beats.text: One eighty-seven, Stanley. Almost there. That's what she said.
Still one eighty-seven.
Nobody say nothing.
